    • build

      public ClassifierNode build()
      Builds the node.
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if the name, classifier or question is not set
      IllegalArgumentException - if the name is empty or contains /, @, or .
      WorkflowConfigurationException - if the question is a Question.Score or has the label Route.DEFAULT_ROUTE_SENTINEL, or if a threshold is set for a Question.Choice or lies outside [0, 1]
